inbox.title: Shared-inbox restyle
inbox.summary: The current Session layout, regions, controls, keys and vocabulary, restyled with shared-inbox conventions: a dense left nav with section headers and counts, Home's feed cards as conversation-list rows, questions and answers as message cards with an author/model/time header, Post content set off as internal notes, and a reply-box composer whose Ask/Post switch reads like a reply/comment toggle. Nothing moves, so current users recognise every screen; new users get clearer row anatomy and states.

variants.label: Light nav, cards
variants.summary: Light navigation column, comfortable list rows, bordered message cards and Post content on a yellow note tint, with avatars removed; author and model stay in each header line.

changes: Sidebar: dense 29 px rows, uppercase FOLDERS section header and right-aligned counts on the existing rows (from the left mailbox nav of shared inboxes); the selected row is a raised white pill.

Home feed cards: conversation-list rows without avatars: sender line (agent · model), subject (thread title), two-line snippet (question), time, status pill and an unread dot (from the inbox message list).
Feed card quick actions: the existing drag grip, Bookmark, Follow and … menu revealed on hover in a floating action pill that replaces the time (from inbox hover actions).
Trays: sticky uppercase group headers with a count pill and chevron, like grouped sections in an inbox list.

Thread page: questions and answers as message cards with a header line (author or agent, model chip, time, status chip); recap as a tinted summary strip; sources as attachment-style chips (from the conversation view).
Post-mode content (posts, the Post composer) styled as internal notes with a yellow tint and a Post label, distinct from Ask messages, like comments versus replies.
Ask box: a reply box with a bottom toolbar; the Ask/Post switch gains text labels and acts as the reply/comment toggle, and the box turns note-yellow in Post mode.
Menus, command palette and toasts: keycap hints on existing shortcuts (A, D, H, ⌘N, ⇧⌘G, ⌘,), a search-bar style palette with a key legend, and a dark floating undo bar.
decisions: Kept as-is: the sidebar order, rail, workspace switcher, column strip with the feed column and one messages | answer pair per level, newest-first message rows with the ask box on top, margin markers, the selection popover (Branch A, Highlight H, Copy), menus and every shortcut.
Kept: the vocabulary and copy (Home, Bookmarks, Highlights, Drafts, Archive, Ask/Post, branch, highlight, recap, star, follow). The Home title stays visually hidden, as in the code.

Added only display polish: counts on sidebar rows (the code shows none), text labels on the Ask/Post segments, a Complete chip next to the existing Queued/Running/Failed pills, keycaps for existing shortcuts.
The brief's E key (Expand) is not in the current code; Highlight already extends an overlapping highlight, so no E was added.
Not adopted: Done/Snooze/Waiting mailboxes and inbox zero, because questions are kept and filed, not cleared; Session has Archive and folders for that.
Not adopted: assignment, assignees, teammate presence and collision indicators, because Session is single-user and Post to network is not built.
Not adopted: triage keys (E to archive, J/K across the list), split inbox, rules and tags replacing folders, because they change the navigation model and the folder/drag-to-file UX.
Not adopted: a fixed three-pane layout with one reading pane, because the column strip and branch pairs are the thread page.

linear.title: Linear restyle
linear.summary: The current Session app with its layout, controls, keys and copy unchanged, restyled in Linear's visual language: a tight Inter type scale, a quiet sidebar beside an inset main panel, Home cards as bordered cards with circular run-status icons, and layered greys with one accent. Menus, the selection bar, the ⌘K palette, run activity and toasts take Linear's popover and keycap styling, so existing shortcuts are visible where they already apply.

variants.label: Bordered cards
variants.summary: Home cards as separate bordered cards; the selected card gets an accent outline instead of a fill bar.

changes: Type scale: Inter at 13 px for UI text with 500-weight labels, 12 px muted metadata and a 14.5 px answer body (Linear's UI type scale and weights).
Sidebar: 28 px rows with 16 px line icons, a subtle selected-row fill, a plain 'Folders' section header, and the main area as an inset panel beside it (Linear's sidebar and app chrome).

Home feed cards: list rows with a leading run-status icon, title, muted question, right-aligned time and agent glyph, and hover-revealed Bookmark, Follow and … actions; folder trays as sticky group headers (Linear's issue list rows and grouped list headers).

Run states: circular icons on the existing states (dashed = Queued, half-filled = Running, filled check = complete, filled cross = Failed, grey cross = Stopped) in feed rows, child rows and message rows (Linear's issue status icons).
Palette: layered greys with one indigo accent in dark, and a matching light theme (Linear's dark and light themes).

Menus, the selection bar, tooltips and branch-marker tips: 9 px radius, hairline border, soft shadow, keycap chips for shortcuts that already exist (A, D, H, ⌘O, ⌘J, ⇧⌘G, ⌘,) (Linear's context menus and tooltips).
⌘K command palette with a large input, section labels and keycap hints; run activity disclosure as a vertical activity timeline (Linear's command menu and issue activity feed).
Composers styled as Linear's comment box; feed toasts as elevated toasts with an Undo action (Linear's comment composer and toasts).
decisions: Kept as-is: sidebar order (Home, Bookmarks, Highlights; Folders: Drafts, user folders, Archive), the 52 px rail and ⇧⌘G, the workspace switcher and account at the sidebar foot, Home's ask box above the feed and the trays below it.

Kept as-is: the column strip of [messages | answer] pairs with branches as further pairs, the composer at the top of the messages column with rows newest first, branch markers in the answer's right margin, the selection bar (Branch A, Highlight H or E, Copy), every menu's items and letter keys, and all copy.
Kept as-is: Settings (Basic, Remotes) and Agent Setup as separate dialogs opened from the sidebar header, the rail and the palette.

Small polish only: the Ask segment shows the model name beside the agent glyph; feed rows show the time and agent the card already has; Bookmark and Follow from the … menu are also revealed on row hover; held-⌘ shortcut chips use keycap styling.
Not adopted: a user-set issue status workflow (Backlog, Todo, In Progress, Done), because run states are set by the run, not by the user.
Not adopted: projects, cycles and triage, because Session's containers are folders and workspaces and it has no planning cadence or inbox.
Not adopted: assignees, priority and labels, because questions have one author and no such fields.
Not adopted: board views and the issue properties sidebar, because the strip already spends horizontal space on branch pairs and nothing in the app maps to properties.
Not adopted: sub-issues in place of branches, because branches are anchored to passages and open as column pairs.
Not adopted: G-then-X navigation chords and a workspace menu at the top of the sidebar, because the app has neither; ⌘N, ⌘O and the foot switcher stay.
